macros.name: boxedsteps
macros.doc: Temporarily (for the current TeX group) changes the effect of \step to issue an \uncover, even if used inside a \stepwise environment.

macros.name: code
macros.doc: Typesets the argument using a boldface typewriter font.

macros.name: codeswitch
macros.doc: Switches to a boldface typewriter font.

macros.name: liststepwise
macros.doc: Same as \stepwise, only an invisible horizontal line is inserted before the ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: nonboxedsteps
macros.doc: Temporarily (for the current TeX group) changes the effect of \step to issue an \only, even if used inside a \parstepwise environment.

macros.name: parstepwise
macros.doc: Same as \stepwise, only \uncover is used instead of \only when mapping the \step command.

macros.name: restep
macros.doc: Same as \step, but the ⟨text⟩ is shown on the same slide as the previous \step command.

macros.name: step
macros.doc: Text contained in a \step command will be enclosed in an \only command with the overlay specification <+(1)->.
